label: Smile Design
title: Conservative Smile Planning
summary: A planning story showing how aesthetic concerns can be reviewed with tooth preservation and gum health in mind.
challenge: The patient wanted a brighter, more balanced smile but was unsure whether aggressive cosmetic treatment was necessary.
approach: The consultation reviewed gum health, shade expectations, enamel preservation, tooth proportions, and a phased conservative plan before cosmetic choices were discussed.
outcome: This case illustrates the planning process, including assessment, sequencing, and a discussion of the alternatives considered.

label: Endodontics
title: Tooth-Preserving Endodontic Care
summary: A case explaining diagnostic workflow when root canal treatment may help preserve a natural tooth.
challenge: The patient reported persistent toothache and needed to understand whether extraction was the only option.
approach: Symptoms, clinical signs, radiographic information, prognosis, restoration needs, and alternatives were explained before treatment decisions.
outcome: The case presents decision-making logic, not a guaranteed result. Real outcomes vary by diagnosis, restorability, and maintenance.

label: Restorative
title: Functional Restoration Plan
summary: A restorative planning example focused on bite comfort, tooth structure preservation, and long-term maintenance.
challenge: A damaged tooth needed restoration, but the treatment choice had to account for chewing forces and remaining tooth structure.
approach: The plan reviewed crack risk, restoration size, material choices, sensitivity expectations, and maintenance responsibilities.
outcome: This case highlights clinical communication and conservative restorative decision-making.

label: Gum Care
title: Gum Health Maintenance Plan
summary: A periodontal guidance story for bleeding gums, plaque control, and realistic home-care routines.
challenge: The patient noticed bleeding while brushing and wanted to know whether it was normal.
approach: The visit reviewed plaque retention areas, brushing pressure, interdental cleaning, gum inflammation, and maintenance intervals.
outcome: The case emphasizes early gum assessment and patient education instead of presenting a guaranteed treatment result.

label: Dental Pain
title: Urgent Toothache Assessment
summary: A workflow for assessing sudden toothache, sensitivity, bite pain, and infection warning signs.
challenge: The patient needed quick clarity about dental pain and whether urgent escalation was required.
approach: The consultation reviewed pain duration, triggers, swelling, biting discomfort, recent restorations, and emergency warning signs.
outcome: The example shows safe triage communication and next-step planning for acute symptoms.

label: Preventive
title: Preventive Family Care Review
summary: A preventive consultation pattern for a family wanting practical, sustainable oral-care guidance.
challenge: The family wanted simple guidance for cavity prevention, sensitivity, and better daily cleaning habits.
approach: Risk factors, diet timing, brushing technique, interdental cleaning, fluoride guidance, and recall timing were discussed.
outcome: The case demonstrates preventive education within a focused specialist practice.

label: Preventive
title: Alignment-Friendly Hygiene Plan
summary: A preventive education case for keeping teeth and gums clean around crowded areas, retainers, or aligner-style appliances.
challenge: The patient found cleaning difficult around tight contacts and wanted a routine that did not feel overwhelming.
approach: The visit reviewed plaque-retentive areas, brush angulation, interdental tool selection, fluoride exposure, and realistic habit-building steps.
outcome: The case shows how personal coaching can support cleaner teeth and healthier gums during alignment-related care.

label: Restorative
title: Cracked Filling Review
summary: A restorative planning example for assessing an older filling, bite pressure, symptoms, and replacement options.
challenge: The patient noticed food trapping and occasional biting discomfort around a large existing filling.
approach: The consultation reviewed margins, remaining tooth structure, crack risk, bite loading, and conservative replacement choices.
outcome: The case demonstrates structured decision-making for a restoration before symptoms become more complex.

label: Smile Design
title: Whitening Readiness Consultation
summary: A cosmetic planning case focused on checking sensitivity, restorations, expectations, and oral health before whitening.
challenge: The patient wanted a brighter smile but had sensitivity and several visible restorations.
approach: The visit reviewed causes of sensitivity, restoration shade limitations, gum condition, and safe timing for whitening.
outcome: The example highlights why cosmetic decisions should be planned after a health and expectation review.

label: Bite Care
title: Night Guard Bite Comfort Plan
summary: A bite-comfort case for patients with grinding signs, jaw fatigue, restoration wear, or morning tooth tenderness.
challenge: The patient reported morning jaw tiredness and visible wear on several teeth.
approach: The assessment considered grinding history, bite contacts, tooth wear, restoration risk, and whether a protective guard was appropriate.
outcome: The case focuses on explaining risk reduction and follow-up rather than promising symptom elimination.

label: Gum Care
title: Gum Recession Sensitivity Review
summary: A gum-care case explaining why exposed root surfaces can feel sensitive and how habits can be adjusted.
challenge: The patient felt cold sensitivity near the gum line and was brushing harder to feel clean.
approach: The consultation reviewed gum recession, brushing pressure, toothbrush selection, sensitivity triggers, and maintenance intervals.
outcome: The case illustrates patient education for protecting gum margins and reducing avoidable irritation.

label: Restorative
title: Crown Replacement Planning
summary: A restorative planning case for reviewing an aging crown, margins, bite comfort, and realistic replacement sequencing.
challenge: The patient was concerned about an older crown that looked uneven and occasionally trapped food.
approach: The assessment reviewed crown margins, gum response, bite contacts, tooth support, and whether other treatment was needed first.
outcome: The case shows how crown decisions can be explained clearly before irreversible treatment begins.

label: Preventive
title: Post-Treatment Maintenance Roadmap
summary: A prevention-focused case for helping patients protect restorations, gums, and comfort after active treatment is complete.
challenge: The patient completed care and wanted to understand how to avoid returning only when something hurts.
approach: A maintenance plan reviewed recall timing, cleaning priorities, bite monitoring, diet frequency, and symptoms that need earlier review.
outcome: The case shows how a personal dental specialist can turn treatment completion into a practical long-term plan.

label: Preventive
title: Diet Risk Cavity Prevention Plan
summary: A preventive counselling case for frequent snacking, acidic drinks, dry mouth, and cavity-risk reduction.
challenge: The patient had repeated early cavities despite brushing daily and wanted to know what was being missed.
approach: The review explored sugar frequency, acidic beverages, fluoride habits, saliva factors, and easy substitutions that fit daily life.
outcome: This case highlights practical risk conversations without blaming the patient or promising guaranteed prevention.

label: Consultation
title: Implant Readiness Discussion
summary: A consultation case explaining how a missing-tooth plan can be discussed with health, bite, gum, and referral considerations.
challenge: The patient wanted to replace a missing tooth but needed clarity about whether an implant was immediately suitable.
approach: The consultation covered gum health, space, bite forces, medical history, imaging needs, alternatives, and referral timing.
outcome: The example demonstrates transparent treatment planning and when specialist referral may be appropriate.

label: Dental Pain
title: Wisdom Tooth Pain Triage
summary: An urgent review case for wisdom-tooth discomfort, swelling risk, cleaning difficulty, and referral decision-making.
challenge: The patient had recurring gum soreness behind the back molar and was worried about infection.
approach: The assessment reviewed swelling, mouth opening, cleaning access, food trapping, bite trauma, and referral criteria.
outcome: The case presents safe triage and clear escalation advice for wisdom-tooth symptoms.

label: Preventive
title: Orthodontic Retainer Care Review
summary: A prevention case for cleaning retainers, protecting gum health, and avoiding relapse-related concerns after alignment treatment.
challenge: The patient wore retainers inconsistently and was unsure how to clean them without damaging them.
approach: The visit discussed wear routine, retainer hygiene, plaque control, gum monitoring, and when to seek orthodontic review.
outcome: This case demonstrates practical maintenance advice after alignment-focused care.

label: Preventive
title: Dry Mouth Prevention Counseling
summary: A patient-education case about dry mouth, cavity risk, sensitivity, medication history, and practical comfort strategies.
challenge: The patient experienced dry mouth and increasing sensitivity, especially at night and on waking.
approach: The review considered hydration, medication history, saliva changes, fluoride support, diet frequency, and warning signs needing medical input.
outcome: The example shows how dental prevention can connect symptoms, risk factors, and daily comfort strategies.
